proposal.description:
# Deploy Uniswap v3 on X Layer
### Summary:
This proposal proposes deploying Uniswap v3 on X Layer. GFX Labs is sponsoring this proposal on behalf of X Layer.

* X Layer will provide $1m of liquidity for a minimum of 6 months via a community multisig.
* Uniswap DAO to provide the front end [cost](https://gov.uniswap.org/t/uniswap-revitalization-and-growth/22616?u=gfxlabs) for Oku Trade.
* At a later date, OKX may create a new proposal seeking UNI incentives.

### Background:
X Layer is a zkEVM Layer 2 network built on Ethereum, powered by Polygon CDK, a zkEVM stack for building Ethereum L2 scaling solutions. Developers can easily deploy their existing contracts on zkEVM, and users can move their assets from Ethereum and conduct transactions off-chain. These transactions are bundled into groups with zero-knowledge proofs to verify their validity.

### Motivation:
Deploying an instance of Uniswap v3 on X Layer provides numerous opportunities for Uniswap to gain millions of new users from the OKX ecosystem which comprises of approximately 50m. This deployment will be a win-win for both parties as it provides Uniswap with a new user base and revenue stream and X Layer the chance to offer its users access to a battle tested DeFi primitive, which is Uniswap v3.


**Boundless scalability:** 100% EVM compatibility and easy-to-use developer tools for deployment.

**X Layer is Powered by OKX:** seamless integration to all OKX products, all-in-one Web3 gateway, and access to 50M+ users in the OKX ecosystem.

**Security:** rely on robust secure mechanisms from Ethereum, with trustless interoperability.

**Low fee:** same coding experience as Ethereum but 100x cheaper.

**Portal to Web3:** enter the world of Web3 via OKX Wallet, built with compact infrastructure modules to create innovative DApps.

## Proposal Stakeholders:
The following list of stakeholders is present to transparently communicate which entities and individuals are involved in proposal creation and implementation.

### Proposer: Yohaan (X Layer DeFi Strategy)
This entity is responsible for authoring the proposal & managing the governance process

#### Deployer: [GFX Labs](https://x.com/labsGFX)
This entity is responsible for the technical deployment of the contracts on the target chain
* GFX Labs will help deploy the v3 contracts on X Layer and has a track record of safely deploying Uniswap v3 on various EVM-compatible chains

#### Frontend: [Oku Trade](https://oku.trade)
The initial frontend where users can interact with the new Uniswap v3 deployment
* Oku is built and managed by GFX Labs
* Oku was seeded by a Uniswap Foundation grant in 2022
* Oku supports twelve chains and continues to aid Uniswap’s expansion to new protocols

**Note:** Oku Trade has become the DAO’s go-to third party front-end for Uniswap deployments since the canonical front-end is owned and operated by Uniswap Labs

#### Bridge Provider: [zkEVM Bridge](https://etherscan.io/address/0x2a3dd3eb832af982ec71669e178424b10dca2ede#writeProxyContract)
X Layer mainnet bridge allows you to seamlessly move value between Ethereum and X Layer mainnet and can also be used to send and claim messages to and from Ethereum and X Layer.

#### Target Chain: [X Layer](https://www.okx.com/xlayer)
This is the chain that v3 contracts are deployed on

#### Proposal Sponsor: [GFX Labs](https://x.com/labsGFX)
This entity has >1M UNI and is therefore eligible for administering the onchain vote

### Liquidity Bootstrapping and Incentives:

#### X Layer’s Commitment:
X Layer commits $1M worth of liquidity to Uniswap pools on X Layer for a minimum of 6 months. All liquidity will be provided on the day of launch. The tokens will be deployed on Uniswap through the X Layer integration with Oku Trade. All liquidity will be provided immediately upon deploying an instance of Uniswap v3 on X Layer.
**Pools and liquidity commitment:**
* $500k in OKB/USDT 0.30%
* $200k in OKB/USDC 0.30%
* $200k in OKB/wETH 0.30%
* $100k in USDC/USDT 0.05%

#### Community Multisig for Liquidity Provisioning:
The liquidity committment made by X layer will be sent to a Gnosis Safe on X Layer prior to launch with signers from OKX, Oku Trade and select Uniswap Delegates.

The Uniswap representatives for the multsig will be PGov (Jun) and Arana (Abdullah).  

#### Deployment Details:
If no major points of contention are posed by the DAO during the RFC, the Accountability Committee will
* Optimistically approve this deployment and consider the deployed contracts on the X layer as canonical, and a comment will be posted on this forum with all the verified contracts
* As is the case with all canonical v3 deployments, this deployment will be subject to Ethereum Layer 1 Uniswap Protocol governance and control. The text record of the uniswap.eth ENS subdomain titled v3-deployments.uniswap.eth will be amended by the Accountability Committee to include the reference to the stated v3 contracts on X Layer.

#### Timeline:
**July 2024:** RFC

**August 2024:** Liquidity commitment Temp Check

**August 2024:** Onchain vote to approve onboarding package

**September 2024:** Uni v3 contracts, as well as the front end on Oku Trade, will be deployed by GFX Labs

dolphin.summary: Adversarial execution scenarios and governance questions available in Deep review.

items.issue: The proposal text does not mention or justify a direct transfer of 16,535 UNI tokens. The proposal discusses X Layer providing $1M in liquidity and Uniswap DAO covering frontend costs for Oku Trade, but does not explain the purpose, recipient, or justification for this specific UNI transfer.

The recipient address (0x3B59C6d0034490093460787566dc5D6cE17F2f9C) is a verified contract deployed on 2024-10-16, not an EOA. The contract's purpose and relationship to the proposal stakeholders is not documented in the proposal text.

The proposal does not disclose what the 16,535 UNI transfer represents (e.g., deployment incentives, team compensation, liquidity mining, etc.) or how it aligns with the stated commitments from X Layer and Uniswap DAO. This creates ambiguity about the true cost and distribution of resources.

dolphin.summary: The executable payload does not match the proposal: it only transfers 16,535 UNI to an unidentified address, with no deployment, multisig, or liquidity actions. This is a high-risk treasury transfer hidden inside a benign deployment proposal.

scenarios.title: Hidden treasury drain via benign deployment proposal
preconditions: Delegates approve based on the proposal text describing only a Uniswap v3 deployment on X Layer
The recipient address 0x3B59C6d0034490093460787566dc5D6cE17F2f9C is controlled by the proposer or an attacker
No separate UNI transfer is disclosed or justified in the proposal

steps.description: Execute the UNI transfer of 16,535 UNI to 0x3B59C6d0034490093460787566dc5D6cE17F2f9C while delegates believe they are approving only an X Layer deployment.

scenarios.impact: 16,535 UNI is irreversibly transferred from the Uniswap treasury to an undisclosed recipient, with no deployment or liquidity commitment enforced by the execution.
scenarios.refutedBy: Needs human delegate review: Scenario assumptions require manual governance review.

scenarios.title: Recipient uses transferred UNI to influence governance or market conditions
preconditions: The recipient address is an EOA or contract controlled by a malicious actor
The 16,535 UNI can be delegated, sold, or used to amplify a future governance attack
Delegates do not verify the recipient's ownership or intended use

steps.description: The transfer sends 16,535 UNI to 0x3B59C6d0034490093460787566dc5D6cE17F2f9C, which can then delegate or sell the tokens.

scenarios.impact: The recipient gains voting power or market liquidity that can be used to influence future Uniswap governance or profit from treasury assets.
scenarios.refutedBy: Needs human delegate review: Scenario assumptions require manual governance review.

scenarios.title: Execution mismatch leaves deployment unenforceable
preconditions: The proposal promises $1M liquidity, multisig setup, and canonical deployment details
The executable action contains no calls to deploy contracts, create a Safe, or fund liquidity
Delegates rely on the on-chain execution as the binding commitment

steps.description: The only executed action is the UNI transfer; none of the stated deployment, multisig, or liquidity obligations are encoded or enforced.

scenarios.impact: The DAO pays UNI while receiving no enforceable on-chain guarantee that X Layer deploys Uniswap v3, provides $1M liquidity, or establishes the promised multisig.
scenarios.refutedBy: Needs human delegate review: Scenario relies on off-chain governance assumptions (multisig key compromise or external signer collusion) that cannot be proved or disproved on-chain.

questions: Why does the executable payload transfer 16,535 UNI when the proposal text states that OKX may seek UNI incentives only at a later date?
Who controls address 0x3B59C6d0034490093460787566dc5D6cE17F2f9C, and what is the legal or operational purpose of this transfer?
Where in the proposal is this 16,535 UNI transfer authorized, budgeted, or disclosed to delegates?

items.issue: The proposal says OKX may create a future proposal seeking UNI incentives, but the executable action transfers 16,535 UNI now.
The recipient address has no disclosed profile, role, or relationship to X Layer, GFX Labs, Oku Trade, or the proposed multisig.
The proposal claims a $1M liquidity commitment and multisig setup, but the executable payload contains no such actions.
